faq.question: What does Noraidah mean?

faq.answer: Noraidah is associated with Arabic. Noraidah is a Malay compound of Arabic نُور (nūr, 'light') + عَائِدَة (ʿĀʾida).

faq.question: Is Noraidah an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form نُورْ عَائِدَة is Arabic.

faq.answer: Noraidah can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.answer: Noraidah should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Nūr occurs in the Quran as a term for light.
